name: fold-stale-edit-of-an-upper-case-name-is-denied-through-an-upper-case-class-on-every-disk
description: The control for fold 13: the same policy and the same file on disk, docs/plan.md, but every request names docs/Plan.md. Session A reads docs/Plan.md, session B reads it, edits it and commits, and A then pre-edits docs/Plan.md. The class [A-Z] accepts P as written, so docs/Plan.md is strict on every disk, none included, whether it opens docs/plan.md (caseless) or names a file of its own (nfd, none), and A is denied as strict_mode 05 denies a stale edit, with the reason and summary.path echoing docs/Plan.md as A sent it, not the disk's docs/plan.md. One expectation for every profile. The two summary timestamps are ignored; every other summary field is compared. Both backends.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: docs/Plan.md was updated by agent 814dac78 at <TS>. Re-read docs/Plan.md via the Read tool before proceeding. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
